snippet.title: Forever Skies | 1.0 Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Forever Skies 1.0 is OUT NOW!

Steam - http://steam.pm/app/1641960 
PS5  - https://store.playstation.com/concept/10004499 
Join our community Discord: https://discord.gg/fnZYv9RYBJ 

Forever Skies is a first-person post-apocalyptic survival game. Play it solo or in co-op and return to Earth, ravaged by an ecological disaster. Build, fly, upgrade and customize your high-tech airship. Craft tools and scavenge resources to survive. Face dangers on the surface and hunt for viruses to cure a mysterious illness.

BlueSky - https://bsky.app/profile/foreverskies.bsky.social
